responsibility: GCC language configuration fragment that declares GNU Modula-2 to the top-level configure/build system. It names the language, compiler executables, stage-specific files, required target libraries, bootstrapping dependency on C++, gengtype source list, and generated outputs such as m2/config-make and m2/Make-maintainer, thereby registering the gm2 front end and its generated support files with GCC’s multi-language build framework.
